body:
Fixes #322

## Problem

`AllocationSizes` documents that an allocation is placed in a dedicated memory block when it does not fit within the configured **maximum** block size. However, `MemoryType::allocate` in `d3d12`, `vulkan`, and `metal` compared `size > allocation_sizes.get_memblock_size(is_host, self.active_general_blocks)` (the *current* growth step rather than `max_*_memblock_size`).

With growable ranges (`min < max`, such as `wgpu`'s `MemoryHints::MemoryUsage` `8..64 MiB` or `Manual` `8..256 MiB`), any resource larger than the current step (e.g., a 2048×2048 RGBA8 texture at `~16.1 MiB` when `active_general_blocks == 1` gives `16 MiB`) was forced into a dedicated heap. Because dedicated blocks do not increment `active_general_blocks`, geometric growth stalled permanently and every subsequent texture/buffer in `(current_step, max]` also created its own dedicated heap.

## Changes

- **`src/lib.rs`**:
  - Added `AllocationSizes::get_max_memblock_size`, `AllocationSizes::get_memblock_size_for_allocation` (starts from `get_memblock_size(is_host, count)` and doubles up to `max_*_memblock_size` until `block_size >= allocation_size`), and `AllocationSizes::should_destroy_empty_general_block`.
  - Updated `AllocationSizes` doc comment to accurately describe geometric advancement and oversized empty-block release.
  - Added 5 unit tests covering growable ranges, non-power-of-two min/max sizes, fixed sizes (`min == max`), boundary values (`0`, `usize::MAX`, `u64::MAX`), and empty-block retention vs oversized-block destruction.
- **`src/d3d12/mod.rs`, `src/vulkan/mod.rs`, `src/metal/mod.rs`**:
  - Compare `size > max_memblock_size` when deciding dedicated allocations.
  - Compute the new shared block size via `get_memblock_size_for_allocation` when existing shared blocks cannot satisfy the allocation.
  - In `MemoryType::free`, destroy empty general blocks when `should_destroy_empty_general_block` is true (`active_general_blocks > 1 || block_size > min_memblock_size`), preventing a single bursty allocation on an empty memory type from permanently pinning an oversized block. Fixed-size ranges (`min == max`) retain 1 block identically to before.

## Isolated A/B Benchmark Results

- **Environment**: Windows 11 (`Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.26300.10075]`), Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, Intel Arc Integrated GPU (UMA, DX12 driver `31.0.101.5328`, Vulkan), `rustc 1.100.0`, `--release`.
- **Isolation & Methodology**: Benchmarked through **unmodified** `gfx-rs/wgpu` `trunk` (`60cef2be`) so the **only** change between baseline (`main` @ `fc22df05`) and candidate (this PR @ `179ea43f`) is `gpu-allocator`. Strictly sequential, alternating single-process runs, `N=5` trials per cell (medians and `(min–max)` ranges reported).
- **Metric distinction**:
  - **Allocator**: `AllocatorReport` (`blocks`, `allocated` = live resources, `reserved` = sum of heap block sizes).
  - **GPU memory**: `IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo` Local `CurrentUsage` *(note: on Intel Arc UMA, Local video memory is backed by shared system RAM)*.
  - **OS process memory**: `GetProcessMemoryInfo` `PrivateWorkingSetSize` (`PrivWS`) and `PrivateUsage` (`Commit`).
- **Reproducible harness & raw data**: [`simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/wgpu-mem-bench`](https://github.com/simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/tree/main/wgpu-mem-bench) | [`results/gpu-allocator-323/summary.md`](https://github.com/simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/blob/main/results/gpu-allocator-323/summary.md) | [`raw/` (100 JSONs)](https://github.com/simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/tree/main/results/gpu-allocator-323/raw)

### `large_textures` (20 × 2048×2048 RGBA8 = 320 MiB payload; `N=5` runs × 20 textures)

| Backend / Range | Variant | Peak Blocks | Alloc / Reserved (MiB) | Peak GPU DXGI Local (MiB) | Peak OS PrivWS / Commit (MiB) | Post-Release Alloc Res / DXGI Local (MiB) | Post-Release OS PrivWS / Commit (MiB) | CPU Create `p50` / `p99` (ms) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DX12 `8..256 MiB` | `main` | 22 `[16.1×20, 8, 4]` | 323.1 / 333.2 | 481.9 | 523.1 / 547.3 | 12.0 / 80.6 | 506.7 / 530.6 (530.6–531.5) | 5.20 (4.69–5.65) / 8.12 |
| DX12 `8..256 MiB` | **#323** | **7** `[256, 128, 64, 32×2, 8, 4]` | 323.1 / 524.0 | 596.6 | 637.6 / 662.0 | 12.0 / 80.6 | **89.6 / 112.9** (112.9–113.1) | **3.47** (3.20–3.68) / 32.22 |
| Vulkan `8..256 MiB` | `main` | 22 `[16.1×20, 8, 4]` | 322.9 / 333.3 | 355.9 | 400.5 / 436.1 | 12.0 / 33.4 | 384.5 / 420.0 (419.8–435.9) | 3.69 (3.60–4.13) / 5.31 |
| Vulkan `8..256 MiB` | **#323** | **7** `[256, 128, 64, 32×2, 8, 4]` | 323.8 / 524.0 | 545.4 | 605.6 / 641.4 | 12.0 / 33.4 | **45.7 / 80.3** (80.3–80.6) | **2.56** (2.51–2.74) / 28.19 |
| DX12 `8..64 MiB` | `main` | 22 `[16.1×20, 8, 4]` | 323.1 / 333.2 | 481.9 | 523.1 / 547.4 | 12.0 / 80.6 | 507.1 / 531.3 (530.6–531.6) | 5.37 (4.75–6.07) / 9.00 |
| DX12 `8..64 MiB` | **#323** | **10** `[64×6, 32×2, 8, 4]` | 323.1 / 460.0 | 532.1 | 573.2 / 597.5 | 12.0 / 80.6 | **283.2 / 306.9** (306.7–307.6) | **4.06** (3.37–5.44) / 11.23 |
| Vulkan `8..64 MiB` | `main` | 22 `[16.1×20, 8, 4]` | 322.9 / 333.3 | 355.9 | 401.1 / 436.5 | 12.0 / 33.4 | 385.0 / 420.4 (419.8–435.9) | 3.71 (3.66–4.48) / 5.71 |
| Vulkan `8..64 MiB` | **#323** | **10** `[64×6, 32×2, 8, 4]` | 323.6 / 460.0 | 481.4 | 541.8 / 577.5 | 12.0 / 33.4 | **237.8 / 272.9** (272.8–273.5) | **2.94** (2.42–3.03) / 8.05 |

### `large_alloc` (`[24, 48, 96, 192, 300] MiB`, `8..256 MiB`) & `churn` (250 mixed `64 KiB..16 MiB` alloc/free cycles)

| Backend / Workload | Variant | Peak Blocks | Alloc / Reserved (MiB) | Post-Release Alloc Res / OS Commit (MiB) | CPU `p50` (min–max) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DX12 `large_alloc` (`8..256 MiB`) | `main` | 7 `[300, 192, 96, 48, 24, 8, 4]` (5 dedicated) | 661.8 / 672.0 | 12.0 / 112.7 | 8.25 ms (6.71–8.90) |
| DX12 `large_alloc` (`8..256 MiB`) | **#323** | 7 `[300, 256, 128, 64, 32, 8, 4]` (1 dedicated) | 661.8 / 792.0 | 12.0 / 113.0 | 10.59 ms (9.68–15.92) |
| Vulkan `large_alloc` (`8..256 MiB`) | `main` | 7 `[300, 192, 96, 48, 24, 8, 4]` (5 dedicated) | 661.6 / 672.0 | 12.0 / 63.4 | 2.26 ms (1.42–3.50) |
| Vulkan `large_alloc` (`8..256 MiB`) | **#323** | 7 `[300, 256, 128, 64, 32, 8, 4]` (1 dedicated) | 661.6 / 792.0 | 12.0 / 63.4 | 1.98 ms (1.86–3.27) |
| DX12 `churn` (`8..256` / `8..64 MiB`) | `main` vs **#323** | 3 `[64, 8, 4]` vs 3 `[64, 8, 4]` | 54.4 / 76.0 (identical) | 12.0 / 225.5 vs 225.8 | 4.8 vs 4.4 us (`8..256`); 6.5 vs 5.3 us (`8..64`) |
| Vulkan `churn` (`8..256` / `8..64 MiB`) | `main` vs **#323** | 3 `[64, 8, 4]` vs 3 `[64, 8, 4]` | 54.2 / 76.0 (identical) | 12.0 / 175.6 vs 175.6 | 2.0 vs 2.0 us (`8..256`); 1.6 vs 1.6 us (`8..64`) |

**Key tradeoff noted transparently**: Because shared power-of-two blocks hold headroom for subsequent suballocations (unlike exact-size dedicated heaps), peak allocator-reserved memory is higher during geometric ramp-up (`333 → 524 MiB` on `8..256 MiB`, `333 → 460 MiB` on `8..64 MiB`) and `p99` reflects the single `256 MiB` heap creation spike (`8.1 → 32.2 ms` on DX12). In exchange, heap count drops **2.2–3.1×** (`22 → 7` / `10`), median per-texture creation drops **21–33%**, geometric growth behaves as documented, post-release OS commit drops **147–418 MiB** on Intel's DX12/Vulkan drivers, and empty oversized blocks are released rather than pinned.

## Verification & Limitations

- Local checks:
  - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: pass
  - `cargo test --no-default-features --features "std,d3d12,vulkan" --lib --tests` (5/5) and `--doc` (7/7): pass
  - `cargo test --no-default-features --features "hashbrown,d3d12,vulkan" --lib` (5/5): pass
  - `cargo clippy --no-default-features --features "std,d3d12,vulkan" --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `--features "hashbrown" --lib -- -D warnings`: pass
  - `cargo check --no-default-features --features "d3d12,vulkan,hashbrown"` (`no_std`): pass
  - `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-Dwarnings" cargo doc --no-deps --no-default-features --features "std,d3d12,vulkan" --document-private-items`: pass
  - Hardware `d3d12-buffer-winrs` and `vulkan-buffer` examples on Windows 11 (Intel Arc iGPU): pass
- **Hardware & platform limitations**:
  - Local benchmarks were collected on an Intel Arc integrated UMA GPU on Windows 11; driver-specific post-release commit retention and heap creation timings may differ on discrete GPUs or AMD/NVIDIA drivers.
  - The Metal backend (`src/metal/mod.rs`) was updated symmetrically and code-reviewed, but not compiled or tested on macOS hardware locally (will be built/tested by macOS CI once approved).
- **AI disclosure**: An AI coding agent assisted with root-cause analysis, implementing the fix/unit tests, running the isolated benchmarks, and drafting this PR description under contributor direction and review.
